box_source: fixed scene fixture in the Menagerie task extension (not estimated)

methods.overhead_rgb: Orange colour component via OpenCV; top-down pinhole XY and depth from known cube edge; reject partial/non-square components. Before first detection hold initial command, on occlusion hold last measured xyz with visible=0 and saturated age. No depth, segmentation buffer, true target or contact enters policy.
methods.legacy_noisy: Original noisy true cube XYZ, Gaussian 5 mm on each axis; numpy Generator seed 1 consumed sequentially.
methods.exact_xyz: Simulator cube centre delivered directly, no noise. Oracle control.
methods.rgb_pick_belief: First unobstructed top-face colour centroid projected onto the surveyed tabletop. Then a distinct encoder adapter updates a possible grasp from known arm FK, gripper closure and distance; release holds the estimated drop location. The actor receives estimate-available instead of pixel-visible, actual RGB acquisition is recorded separately. No true cube coordinates or contact.
methods.constant_pick_belief: Same encoder/closure adapter, identical estimate-available input; fixed workspace midpoint replaces initial RGB.
methods.constant: Workspace midpoint [.24,-.06,.016] m throughout, visible=1, age=0.

success: Original scorer: open separated gripper, stationary cube inside bin for at least 0.5 s
contact_lift: Cube rose >30 mm above initial centre while both fixed and moving jaw bodies contacted it at a 30 Hz observation
scope: Easy nominal fixture; static monocular calibration from camera design; no physical success claim
primary_comparison: rgb_pick_belief vs constant_pick_belief, exact two-sided McNemar test of discordant paired outcomes
